title: 第二十五章 额滴都是额滴第二十六章 青玄玉果让老修士燃了起来
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 三人齐齐一怔，然后陆恒轻笑了起来。
“只是刚才有些事要谈，故而才离道友远了一些。”
“谈事？什么事，不知能否与在下说一说？”
秦凡语气淡然，说话间，已是御使金剪刀挖出了妖丹。
“这恐怕不行。”
陆恒摇了摇头，抱歉道：“此事乃是我宗门机密，所以……”
“机密？”
秦凡讥讽一笑，旋即意味深长的看着三人，道：“灵光山好歹也是仙门大派，三位道友所说的机密，应该不是指让在下做饵，好引妖兽前来吧？”
既已明白对方在自己身上做的手段，那秦凡也懒得和他们再浪费时间。
听见秦凡戳破谋划，三人一齐变了脸色，旋即眼中皆浮现出冷冽寒意。
“你都猜到了？”
陆恒眯眼注视着秦凡。
“不得不说，何道友先前拍我肩膀那一下，力道着实有些重了。”
秦凡双手背后，带着些许嘲讽的看着三人。
何修文不由眉头轻皱，“你既已有所察觉，又为何要跟我等进山？”
“你猜呢？”
秦凡似笑非笑的望着何修文。
“难道你有所依仗？”
何修文狐疑的对秦凡问道。
“也可能是隐藏了境界，你觉得呢？”
何修文面色微变，但随后便突地笑了起来，“来大青山杀妖，你就算隐藏了境界又如何？你总不可能是筑基期修士吧？哪位筑基期修士会浪费时间过来这里？”
摇了摇头，何修文觉得秦凡多半是故布疑阵。
“我若没猜错的话，你应当是才反应过来。”
一旁的陆恒也嘲讽的看着秦凡，“你说这些，不外乎就是想让我等忌惮，只可惜啊，你太低估我等了，我们可没你想的那么愚蠢。”
秦凡哑然一笑，随后摇了摇头。
这人要自作聪明起来，真是害人害己。
“师兄，我看还是别和他废话了，教训他一下，让他知道知道，他的小命究竟掌握在谁的手上。”
陈滢冷冷一笑，略有不耐的对陆恒道。
“也好。”
陆恒看了眼何修文，给他递了个眼神。
“那便我来吧。”
何修文轻轻一笑，手掌轻翻，一捆青色绳索出现在手上，泛着淡绿光晕。
content_en:
The three of them were startled, and then Lu Heng chuckled.
"It's just that I had something to talk about just now, so I stayed away from my fellow Taoist."
"Talk about something? What's the matter? I wonder if you can talk to me about it?"
Qin Fan's tone was calm. As he spoke, the imperial emissary's golden scissors dug out the demon pill.
"I'm afraid that won't work."
Lu Heng shook his head and apologized: "This matter is a secret of my sect, so..."
"Secret?"
Qin Fan smiled sarcastically, then looked at the three of them meaningfully, and said: "Lingguang Mountain is also a major sect of immortals after all. The secrets mentioned by the three fellow Taoists should not be used as bait to attract the monsters, right?"
Now that he understood what the other party was doing to him, Qin Fan didn't bother to waste time with them anymore.
Hearing Qin Fan expose the plan, the three of them all changed their expressions, and immediately a cold chill appeared in their eyes.
"You guessed it all?"
Lu Heng narrowed his eyes and stared at Qin Fan.
"I have to say that the way Fellow Daoist He patted me on the shoulder was a little too strong."
Qin Fan looked at the three of them with a little mockery behind his hands.
He Xiuwen couldn't help but frown slightly, "Since you have noticed it, why do you want to wait with me into the mountain?"
"What do you think?"
Qin Fan looked at He Xiuwen with a half-smile.
"Do you have something to rely on?"
He Xiuwen asked Qin Fan suspiciously.
"Maybe he's hiding his realm, what do you think?"
He Xiuwen's expression changed slightly, but then he suddenly laughed, "Come to Daqingshan to kill monsters, so what if you hide your realm? You can't be a Foundation Establishment monk, right? Which Foundation Establishment monk would waste time coming here?"
Shaking his head, He Xiuwen felt that Qin Fan was probably just raising suspicion.
"If I'm not wrong, you should have just reacted."
Lu Heng, who was on the side, also looked at Qin Fan mockingly, "You are just saying this to make me afraid. It's a pity that you underestimate me too much. We are not as stupid as you think."
Qin Fan smiled hoarsely, then shook his head.
If this person tries to be smart, he is really harming others and himself.
"Senior brother, I think it's better not to talk nonsense with him, teach him a lesson, and let him know whose hands his life is in."
Chen Ying smiled coldly and said to Lu Heng impatiently.
"That's fine."
Lu Heng glanced at He Xiuwen and gave him a look.
"Then let me do it."
He Xiuwen smiled softly, turned his palms slightly, and a bundle of cyan ropes appeared in his hands, glowing with a light green halo.
title_en: Chapter 25: Every drop is a drop in the forehead. Chapter 26: The Green Mysterious Jade Fruit makes the old monk ablaze.
